title: A Blade Hidden Behind a Smile
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought everything was under his control, the Imperial Court emissary slowly lifted his mask—and that face bore a startling seven-point resemblance to his sister Chen Nian, whom he hadn't seen in years!

text.content: "The Ultimate Hall..." Chen Ji murmured the four words, his fingertips unconsciously rubbing the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms. That whisper from the depths of heaven's dao still echoed in his ears, as chilling as a winter night wind. He raised his head toward the horizon, where thunder light flickered within churning dark clouds, as if some ancient existence was awakening. Three days ago, that face in the Void identical to his own, that bizarre prophecy—now there was finally an answer. The door to the Ultimate Hall had truly opened. "Master Mo, you knew the danger within this all along, didn't you?" he whispered to the fragment, yet a wry smile curved his lips. "Unfortunately, this junior has never believed in evil omens. The more forbidden the place, the more I must go take a look."

dialogue.content: "Believe in evil omens? This old man thinks you're the one who believes in evil." A hoarse laugh came from the fragment, Master Mo's voice. "However, the opening of the Ultimate Hall will inevitably alarm the Imperial Court. If you wish to set the world as your board, the game in the Imperial Capital is unavoidable."

text.content: Chen Ji nodded deeply in agreement. Though the Ultimate Hall had opened, if he wanted to seize even a thread of advantage in the storm's eye, the Imperial Court's secret gathering would be the best source of intelligence. He summoned a trusted servant and whispered a few instructions. Half a stick of incense later, an attendance invitation from a border town "Waste Chen" arrived at the Imperial Capital's courier station. The name "Waste Chen" was a laughingstock throughout the Tianqing Sect and the entire cultivation world—a Foundation Building initial stage Servant Disciple, so worthless that naturally no one would connect him with a hidden piece. "Interesting." Chen Ji changed into a faded blue robe, grinning at his reflection in the bronze mirror. "A waste product attending an Imperial Court secret meeting—what a fine joke."

dialogue.content: "Remember, once inside the Imperial Capital, I am that waste Chen whose spiritual roots are even crooked." Chen Ji adjusted his collar before the bronze mirror, a glint of cunning flickering in his gaze. "If anyone asks about my cultivation, I'll say 'barely surviving.' If they ask about my origins, I'll say 'the one who sweeps floors at Tianqing Sect.' If they ask what skills I have—" He paused, the corners of his mouth rising. "I'll say, I'm good at fortune-telling."

choice.prompt: At the Imperial Capital's city gate, Chen Ji was questioned by guards while queuing to enter. How do you choose to respond?

choices.description: Present the Tianqing Sect Servant Token, using the most humble posture to slip through
choices.risk_hint: May encounter someone who knows the Tianqing Sect

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, presenting his token with the utmost humility. The guard glanced at the "Tianqing Sect Servant" characters on the token, a sneer curling his lips: "Tianqing Sect? What kind of cats and dogs can attend Imperial Court meetings these days? Go ahead, don't block the way." Chen Ji thanked him profusely, looking grateful to the extreme, but inside he was coldly laughing—remember this, that debt will be settled later.

choices.description: Pretend not to understand the guard's words, repeatedly asking "What's a meeting?" and "Can I enter?" using nonsense to buy time while lowering vigilance
choices.visible_reward: Makes the guard completely relax their guard

text.content: "What? A meeting? What meeting?" Chen Ji stared wide-eyed, his face blank with confusion. "I'm just here to deliver goods, delivering firewood to the Ministry of Rites! What? I have a token? What token? Oh this? My master gave it to me, said I could enter the city without paying..." The guard's head throbbed listening to this. He waved him through like shooing a fly: "Get lost! Stop wasting my time here!" Chen Ji thanked him with exaggerated gratitude as he entered the city. Behind him came the guard's cursing: "Damn it, these days even idiots can get into the Imperial Capital!" A slight smile touched his lips—the better to be an idiot, since idiots draw no suspicion.

choices.description: Pull out a forged token of a third-rate noble family heir, infiltrating as a "small person"

text.content: Chen Ji leisurely produced a token inscribed with "Qingyun Chen" characters. The guard glanced at the third-rate noble family emblem on the token, and his attitude immediately became thirty percent more courteous: "So you're from the Qingyun Chen family, my apologies, my apologies. Please, go right in." Chen Ji clasped his hands and bowed, looking overwhelmed by the unexpected courtesy. Only when he was far away did he mutter to himself: "Qingyun Chen family? My apologies, just borrowing your name. The debt your Chen family owes me Chen Ji will be repaid by this Imperial Court." A cold light flashed in his eyes—three years ago the Chen family discarded him like refuse, today he would use their name to stir up the winds of change in this Imperial Capital.

The location of the imperial secret meeting was set in the side hall next to the Taihe Hall. When Chen Ji arrived, dozens of people had already gathered inside. His gaze swept across the room, categorizing everyone into hierarchies—the one sitting in the main seat was the Minister of Rites in the imperial court, dressed in purple robes, his face as still as water; on both sides stood representatives from various sects, some arrogant and overbearing, others lost in contemplation; and a few who were clearly from minor sects or wandering cultivators, huddled in the corners, not daring to breathe loudly. Chen Ji naturally made his way to the most inconspicuous spot in the corner, but unexpectedly, an arrogant voice stopped him: "Oh, isn't this the waste from the Tianqing Sect? How could someone like you even attend the imperial secret meeting?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to look. The one who stopped him was a young lord in brocade robes with a jade belt, waving a folding fan, wearing an expression of utter disdain. Behind him followed a few attendants, one of whom whispered: "This is Young Lord Qian Duoduo, son of the Vice Minister of Rites." Chen Ji almost burst out laughing—Qian Duoduo? Such an earthy name? He repeated it three times in his mind, confirming he hadn't misheard. "So it's Young Lord Qian." Chen Ji clasped his hands in a bow, his posture so humble it seemed to touch the dust, "This junior is indeed a servant from the Tianqing Sect. Being able to attend such a grand gathering is truly my greatest fortune across three lifetimes."

nodes.content: Qian Duoduo sneered, snapped his fan shut, and pointed at Chen Ji: "A waste is a waste, even your spiritual root is crooked. What are you doing at this secret meeting? Serving tea and pouring water for the seniors?" A few low laughs rang out from the surroundings. Yet Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, even showing a shy smile: "Young Lord Qian is right, this junior is indeed here to serve tea and pour water. However..." He paused, looking around, "This junior also has another skill—fortune-telling. I wonder if Young Lord Qian would be interested in having this junior divine your fortune?"

choice.prompt: Qian Duoduo demands you to divine his fortune on the spot. How do you choose to display the 'waste's' fortune-telling abilities?

choices.description: Use the most absurd nonsense to tell fortunes that make absolutely no sense, letting everyone mock 'the waste is indeed a waste'
choices.risk_hint: May be kicked out of the secret meeting

text.content: Chen Ji cleared his throat and pretended to be profound: "Young Lord Qian, I observe your facial features—the space between your brows is dark, and you have a mole at your brow center—this is... this is... oh, this is the face of wealth!" Qian Duoduo froze for a moment, then burst into hearty laughter: "The face of wealth? Do I need divination for that? My Qian family is the wealthiest in the entire dynasty! A waste is a waste, can't even tell fortunes properly!" The laughter around grew louder, and even the Minister of Rites at the main seat shook his head slightly. Yet Chen Ji seriously added: "Young Lord Qian, please don't be impatient. This junior hasn't finished. Your brow center is dark—you may suffer financial losses within three days; the mole at your brow center has hair growing on it, and the hair has thorns, and flowers bloom on those thorns—and the flowers that bloom are white flowers." Qian Duoduo's laughter stopped abruptly, his face turning sharp: "What did you say?"

choices.description: Secretly activate the Tianji Record to precisely calculate Qian Duoduo's unfortunate events tomorrow, startling him on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingertips lightly tapping his knee as he pretended to divine. In reality, his consciousness had sunk into the Tianji Record Fragment, peering into Qian Duoduo's fate within the next three hours—tomorrow at the Mao hour, he would go to the gambling house in the east of the city and lose all his silver; at the Wu hour, he would encounter a woman in white, mistaking her for a beauty, but she was actually a swindler; at the You hour, he would fall from his carriage and break his face. "Young Lord Qian." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze profound, "Tomorrow at the Mao hour, the gambling house in the east of the city; at the Wu hour, a beauty in white; at the You hour, carriage nightmare. These three events, if even one does not occur, this junior will gouge out both eyes on the spot." Qian Duoduo's face changed dramatically, because these three events—were exactly the itinerary he had planned for after the secret meeting!

choices.description: Deliberately leave things half-said, hinting that Qian Duoduo has 'imminent bloody disaster' without being clear, whetting his appetite until he begs for more
choices.visible_reward: Make Qian Duoduo take the bait voluntarily

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head and sighed: "Young Lord Qian, there are some words this junior doesn't know if they should be spoken." Qian Duoduo frowned: "Spit it out!" Chen Ji sighed again, lowering his voice even more: "This junior observes Young Lord's facial features—there may be a bloody disaster within three days. It's not that this junior is unwilling to say, but... but once these words are spoken, I'm afraid Young Lord cannot bear it." Qian Duoduo's face slightly changed, yet he forced a calm demeanor: "Hmph, playing tricks with mystery! A waste like you, what can you possibly calculate?" Chen Ji turned to leave: "Then this junior won't speak out of turn. Young Lord, take care." But Qian Duoduo panicked, grabbing Chen Ji's sleeve: "Stop! Tell me clearly, what bloody disaster exactly!" Chen Ji turned back, his gaze profound: "Does Young Lord truly wish to hear? Once heard, there will be no turning back for Young Lord."

Just as Qian Duoduo's face was ashen and everyone was whispering, the Minister of Rites at the main seat suddenly spoke: "Enough." His voice was not loud, yet it carried undeniable authority, "The secret meeting hasn't even begun, yet you all are making such a ruckus here. What kind of behavior is this?" Qian Duoduo immediately released Chen Ji's sleeve and bowed respectfully: "Please forgive me, Minister, this junior was rude." The Minister of Rites' gaze swept over Chen Ji, lingering for a moment, then suddenly asked: "So you are Chen Ji from the Tianqing Sect?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression became even more humble: "Reporting to the Minister, this junior is indeed Chen Ji. I wonder if the Minister has any orders?" The Minister of Rites said lightly: "This official has heard that the Tianqing Sect has a waste disciple who made no progress in Foundation Building for three years, yet somehow can attend the imperial secret meeting... Interesting." He paused, "You may take your seat. Later, this official has something to ask you."

Chen Ji sat properly in the corner, but his heart was churning like the ocean in turmoil. The Minister of Rites knew about him? And from his tone, it seemed like it wasn't just simple 'knowledge.' He quietly activated the Tianji Record Fragment, attempting to peer into this Minister's background, yet what appeared before his eyes was a blur of mist—someone had obscured this Minister's heavenly secrets! "Master Mo, do you recognize this Minister?" Chen Ji asked softly in his heart. From within the Fragment came Master Mo's grave voice: "Recognized, and not recognized. This Minister, three months ago, was still a sixth-rank official clerk in the Ministry of Rites. In one night, he was promoted three full ranks, directly taking the position of Minister. Guess—who stands behind him?" Chen Ji's heart tightened: "Who?" Master Mo was silent for a moment: "The Empress Dowager behind the scenes... the Grand Empress Dowager."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, yet his expression remained unmoved. The Grand Empress Dowager, the actual power-holder of the dynasty, even the Emperor had to defer to her wishes. A figure like this, suddenly promoting a Ministry of Rites clerk, and specifically naming him at the secret meeting... This was by no means coincidence. "Interesting." A slight smile curved his lips, and he had already made his calculations, "It seems this game is more complicated than I imagined. But that's fine—the murkier the waters, the easier to fish in them." He quietly took out a jade talisman from his sleeve and activated it with spiritual energy. The talisman instantly transformed into a fly invisible to the naked eye, flying toward the northwest of the imperial capital. That was the Xuanwu Sect's secret stronghold in the capital—Han Lie's men were waiting for his instructions.

text.content: The secret meeting officially began. The Minister of Rites scanned his surroundings and said in a low voice: "Gentlemen, today's secret meeting addresses only one matter—the Ultimate Hall." At these words, a sudden uproar filled the hall. The Ultimate Hall, a legendary forbidden land said to contain the ultimate secrets of the Heavenly Dao, supposedly even ancient powerhouses could not glimpse its full extent. And now it had actually opened? "The Imperial Court has already sent envoys to investigate," the Minister of Rites continued. "But before they return, the Court needs to know the stance of the major sects—regarding the opportunities of the Ultimate Hall, will you fight for it, or concede?"

choice.prompt: The Minister of Rites demanded that each major sect declare their position. How do you choose to respond?

choices.description: Maintain thetrashpersona, let other sects express their positions first, and chime in last
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to express your position
choices.risk_hint: Might be singled out by the Minister

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, looking as if the matter had nothing to do with him. Several major sects indeed stepped forward without hesitation. The Xuanwu Sect declared they would "fully compete for the opportunities," the Holy Sect of Demonic Path ambiguously stated they were "willing to cooperate with the Imperial Court," and a Tianqing Sect elder even pledged solemnly: "The Ultimate Hall is a public treasure of the world, and our Tianqing Sect is willing to share the Court's burdens." Just as everyone finished expressing their positions, the Minister of Rites suddenly looked toward Chen Ji: "Tianqing Sect member, what are your thoughts?" Chen Ji froze—of course, there's no way to stay low-profile. He forced himself to stand, clasped his hands, and said: "Respected Minister, this insignificant one is merely a servant disciple. How could I possibly have any opinions? However... this insignificant one has heard that when the Ultimate Hall opens, there will certainly be celestial omens. Why not observe the celestial signs first, then decide?" A glimmer of appreciation flashed in the Minister of Rites' eyes: "Oh? You understand celestial observation?"

choices.description: Use thetrashpersona's crooked logic to steal the spotlight, throwing out the absurd theory of "yielding benefits to the people" to draw the Minister's attention
choices.risk_hint: May be targeted by various sects

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, his voice not loud but clear enough to reach everyone: "Respected seniors, this insignificant one dares to speak. Regarding the opportunities of the Ultimate Hall, instead of fighting each other to the death, why not... why not divide them equally?" "Divide equally?" The Xuanwu Sect elder coldly laughed. "Does atrashdare to discuss the distribution of opportunities?" Chen Ji spoke with a serious expression: "Senior, please don't be impatient. This insignificant one's meaning is that since the Ultimate Hall is called 'Ultimate,' it certainly cannot be tolerated by a single person. Instead of fighting separately, why not form an alliance to jointly explore the forbidden land? As for the opportunities... whoever contributes more gets a larger share. Isn't that more dignified than killing each other?" He paused, looking at the Minister of Rites. "Of course, this is merely this insignificant one's humble opinion. How to specifically distribute the opportunities still requires the Minister's decision." The Minister of Rites slightly raised the corner of his mouth: "Interesting. Continue."

choices.description: While everyone's attention is on expressing their positions, secretly use spiritual sense to send a message to the Xuanwu faction, letting them cause disruption
choices.visible_reward: Let the Minister see the connection between Xuanwu and yourself

text.content: Just as the various sects were arguing endlessly, sudden commotion came from outside the hall. Then, a guard rushed in: "Minister! Xuanwu Sect's Young Master Han Lie requests an audience, saying he has important matters to report!" The Minister of Rites frowned: "Han Lie? Wasn't he in seclusion? Let him in." A moment later, Han Lie strode into the hall, dressed in black robes, his aura imposing. His gaze swept across the crowd before finally landing on Chen Ji, who was pretending to be a quail in the corner. A cold smile curled his lips. Chen Ji cursed internally—this idiot, wasn't he supposed to wait outside? Why did he come in on his own? Han Lie seemed not to see him, directly clasping his hands toward the Minister of Rites: "Minister, the junior has something to expose—the opening of the Ultimate Hall is related to demonic path remnants!" At these words, the hall erupted.

Chen Ji lowered his head, but the corner of his mouth twitched slightly. This idiot Han Lie had actually barged into the secret meeting uninvited, and threw out a topic like "demonic path remnants"—what was he trying to do? Did he not know that Ye Qing was secretly cooperating with him? He quietly used spiritual sense to transmit: "Han Lie, what are you doing?" Han Lie seemed not to hear, continuing to speak with great passion: "The junior has conclusive evidence proving that Ye Qing, the saintess of the Holy Sect of Demonic Path, has a direct relationship with the opening of the Ultimate Hall! The junior implores the Minister to order a thorough investigation of the demonic path remnants!" The Minister of Rites' expression remained unchanged, but his gaze fell on Chen Ji, seemingly waiting to see what reaction he would have. Alarm bells rang in Chen Ji's heart—was Han Lie trying to publicly betray Ye Qing? Or was someone... using Han Lie's hand to test him?

dialogue.content: At this critical moment, Chen Ji did something that surprised everyone—he stood up and clasped his hands toward the Minister of Rites: "Minister, the junior dares to interject." The Minister of Rites raised an eyebrow: "Oh? What do you have to say?" Chen Ji gave a simple smile: "Regarding the demonic path remnants that Young Master Han mentioned, this junior doesn't quite understand. But this junior has heard that the Xuanwu Sect and the Holy Sect of Demonic Path have always been incompatible. Why suddenly care about demonic matters? Could it be... that Young Master Han wants to use the Imperial Court's hand to eliminate rivals?" He paused, looking innocent: "Of course, this junior might be overthinking. After all, this junior is merely atrash, and doesn't understand the affairs of major sects." At these words, whispered discussions erupted throughout the hall. The Xuanwu Sect elder's face turned ashen with anger, and Han Lie trembled with rage: "trash! You're spouting nonsense!" Chen Ji shrank back: "Young Master Han, please calm down. This junior really was just speaking casually..."

text.content: The Minister of Rites suddenly clapped his hands, signaling everyone to be quiet. He looked deeply at Chen Ji, as if seeing this "trash" properly for the first time: "Chen Ji, you certainly have a sharp tongue." Chen Ji lowered his head: "Minister flatters me. This junior only speaks the truth." The Minister of Rites contemplated for a moment, then suddenly announced: "Today's secret meeting ends here. Regarding the matter of the Ultimate Hall, the Imperial Court will decide. Everyone may leave." The crowd looked at each other but dared not disobey. They all rose and took their leave. As Han Lie left, he glared fiercely at Chen Ji, his eyes full of venom. Chen Ji responded with an innocent smile, but in his heart he was rapidly calculating—Han Lie's performance today was definitely not his own idea. Behind him, someone was pulling strings. Who? The Minister of Rites? Or... the Grand Empress Dowager?

After everyone had dispersed, the Minister of Rites specifically kept Chen Ji behind. He waved away his attendants, leaving only the two of them in the hall. The Minister of Rites sat at the main seat, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Chen Ji, I have three questions for you. If you answer truthfully, today's matter will be dropped; if you dare speak even one falsehood—" His voice turned icy cold. "I will show you how atrashbecomes a dead thing." Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, but he maintained his humble posture: "Please ask, Minister. This junior will answer everything." The Minister of Rites asked his first question: "Where were you on the day the Ultimate Hall opened?" Chen Ji replied: "Minister, this junior was sweeping the courtyard at the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters." The Minister of Rites asked again: "Have you heard of the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face showed complete bewilderment: "Tianji Record? What's that? Can you eat it?"

dialogue.content: The Minister of Rites stared at him for a moment, then suddenly smiled: "Interesting." He stood up and slowly walked to Chen Ji, lowering his voice: "My third question—are you familiar with the mysterious power of the Ultimate Hall?" Chen Ji's eyes flickered with curiosity, but he maintained his humble demeanor. The Minister of Rites studied his reaction carefully, seemingly searching for something. The tension in the air was palpable, with secrets and hidden intentions lurking beneath the surface of their exchange.

text.content: "Chen Ji walked out of the side hall of Taihe Palace, the sunlight outside somewhat dazzling. He raised his head to look at the sky, the corner of his mouth curving into a cold smile. The Minister of Rites had asked him three questions: his whereabouts, the Tianji Record, and Chen Nian—this was clearly testing the connection between him, the Ultimate Hall, the Tianji Record, and his sister Chen Nian. 'It seems someone already suspects me.' he murmured to himself, 'Though this Minister of Rites probably knows even more than I do.' He took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions in his heart—Chen Nian's name spoken from the mouth of a court minister meant his sister was still alive, and had some connection to the imperial court. 'Chen Nian, where are you?' he called in his heart, 'Wait for brother, brother will definitely find you.' Suddenly, footsteps echoed outside the hall. A middle-aged man in splendid robes strode over, his face refined yet revealing an aura of sinister ruthlessness. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly—the aura emanating from this person was actually at the Transformation God realm! And this aura felt somewhat familiar... The robed man walked up to him, smiling faintly: 'Chen Ji? I've long heard your name.' Chen Ji cupped his fists: 'May I know the elder's esteemed name?' The robed man's smile deepened: 'This one's surname is Han, appointed as Xuanwu Sect's Supreme Elder—Han Mo.'

"Han Mo. Xuanwu Sect's Supreme Elder, Han Lie's grandfather, the true power holder of the entire Xuanwu Sect. Alarm bells rang in Chen Ji's heart, but his expression became even more humble: 'So it turns out to be Elder Han, I失礼。请见谅。' Han Mo scrutinized him as if examining an interesting plaything: 'You're quite interesting. Just now inside the hall, you had that fool Han Lie eating out of your hand—I've never seen him suffer such a huge loss.' Chen Ji forced a bitter smile: 'Elder is too kind, I was merely defending myself...' Han Mo suddenly lowered his voice: 'Defending yourself? This one thinks you're playing a very elaborate game.' He gave Chen Ji a meaningful look, 'The Ultimate Hall has opened, with Tianqing, Xuanwu, and the Demonic Path forming a three-way confrontation... Which side are you on?'

choice.prompt: "Han Mo personally came forward to recruit, the Xuanwu Sect Supreme Elder's questions hiding lethal intent. How do you choose to respond?"

choices.description: "Express willingness to serve Xuanwu Sect in exchange for protection and resources"
choices.risk_hint: "Someone inside Xuanwu Sect knows Chen Nian"

text.content: "Chen Ji seemed intimidated by Han Mo's imposing aura, nodding repeatedly: 'Elder flatters this one. Such atrash like me wouldn't dare take sides. If Elder doesn't嫌弃, this one is willing to serve Xuanwu Sect with dedication.' A flash of satisfaction crossed Han Mo's eyes, yet he maintained his scrutiny: 'Good. A wise man knows when to yield. This one particularly likes clever people like you.' He took out a jade pendant from his sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji, 'This is this one's token. With this jade pendant, everyone at Xuanwu Sect is at your disposal.' Chen Ji received it with both hands, expressing countless thanks. Han Mo patted his shoulder, lowering his voice: 'However, this one has one condition—your sister Chen Nian has some connection with this one. If you obtain any news of her, you must inform this one immediately.' Chen Ji's heart shook violently, yet his face showed only confusion: 'Chen Nian? My sister? Does Elder know her?' Han Mo stared at him for a long moment, then suddenly smiled: 'It seems you truly don't know. No matter, we'll discuss this later.' He turned to leave, leaving behind a meaningful remark, 'Remember, the imperial envoys will arrive at the capital in three days. By then, you'll meet some... interesting people.'

choices.description: "Decline with atrash persona, stating you only wish to quietly sweep floors"

text.content: "Chen Ji forced a bitter smile, shaking his head: 'Elder's kindness, this one is deeply grateful. It's just that this one truly has no abilities; going to Xuanwu Sect would only embarrass Elder. This one only wishes to sweep floors at Tianqing Sect, ending life quietly...' The smile on Han Mo's face gradually vanished, replaced by a trace of coldness: 'Sweep floors? You think this one is a fool?' He stepped forward, pressure suddenly released, 'Chen Ji, this one advises you to think carefully before answering. In this world, no one can act foolishly before this one.' Chen Ji was forced back three steps, face turning pale, yet still insisted: 'Elder please calm your anger, this one truly is just atrash...' Han Mo stared at him for a long while, then suddenly coldly laughed: 'Fine, very fine. This one shall see how long you can keep pretending to be atrash.' He swept his sleeves and left, leaving behind a harsh warning, 'When the imperial envoys arrive in three days, you'd better pray you're still alive.'"

choices.description: "Use rhetoric to extract information, see how much Han Mo actually knows about Chen Nian"
choices.visible_cost: "May expose your concern for Chen Nian"

text.content: "Chen Ji seemed shaken by Han Mo's imposing aura, falling silent for a moment, then suddenly switching to a pleading expression: 'Elder... This one truly wishes to serve Xuanwu Sect, but... but this one has an obsession in their heart, not sure if it's appropriate to speak of it.' Han Mo raised an eyebrow: 'Speak.' Chen Ji gritted his teeth: 'My sister Chen Nian went missing three years ago. This one has been searching for her, yet has never found any clues. I've heard... heard she was taken by the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. This one wishes to beg Elder for help, to rescue my sister. This one is willing to use this as the price, to serve Xuanwu Sect.' As he spoke, he actually knelt down. A strange glint flashed in Han Mo's eyes: 'Your sister? Heavenly Fate Key?' Chen Ji's heart shook—Heavenly Fate Key! Han Mo actually knew Chen Nian's identity! He suppressed the shock, looking up: 'This one doesn't know what a Heavenly Fate Key is, only that she is my sister...' Han Mo fell silent for a long while, then suddenly laughed uproariously: 'Interesting, very interesting! Chen Ji, oh Chen Ji, you've presented this one with quite a dilemma!'"

"When Chen Ji left Taihe Palace, the sunset was already slanting westward. His steps were hurried, yet his heart churned like the sea in storm. In today's secret meeting, he obtained three crucial pieces of intelligence: First, the Minister of Rites had behind him the Grand Empress Dowager, this real power holder of the court who was determined to secure the Ultimate Hall; second, Xuanwu Sect's Supreme Elder Han Mo personally came to recruit, and he actually knew Chen Nian's identity as 'Heavenly Fate Key'; third, imperial envoys would arrive at the capital in three days, when 'interesting people' would appear. Each piece of intelligence implied another layer of the chess game, and Chen Ji had to find his own path to survival sandwiched between these three chess games. 'Heavenly Fate Key...' he murmured, 'So Chen Nian has this identity. No wonder the Holy Sect wanted to capture her, no wonder so many forces are searching for her.' He clenched his fists, 'But this further proves she's still alive. As long as she's alive, I can find her.'"

"Suddenly, a familiar spiritual sense transmission entered his mind—it was Ye Qing's voice: 'Chen Ji, is the secret meeting over? I received news that fool Han Lie made a scene in the hall, are you alright?' Chen Ji's mouth curved slightly, transmitting voice in reply: 'I'm fine, already resolved. But there's something I must tell you—Han Mo just visited me, he knows Chen Nian is a Heavenly Fate Key.' Ye Qing fell silent for a moment: 'Han Mo... The one standing behind him is even more dangerous than Han Mo. I've investigated the imperial envoys arriving in three days—they're the Grand Empress Dowager's favored one. If I guess correctly, that person has a significant connection with your Chen family...' Chen Ji knit his brows tightly: 'What connection?' Ye Qing's voice became grave: 'You'll know in three days. Before then, act carefully. The door to the Ultimate Hall has opened, and the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye... is clearer than ever before.'"

"It was deep in the night, Chen Ji stood alone before the inn's window, gazing at the countless lights of the imperial capital. The Ultimate Hall had already opened, the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye following like a shadow, and every step he took in this grand game of heaven and earth was like walking on thin ice. The imperial secret meeting was merely the beginning; the true storm was still to come. 'The imperial envoys arriving in three days...' he murmured to himself, 'Who exactly is it?' Suddenly, a white shadow passed outside the window. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, about to make a move, yet saw that white shadow stop on the windowsill—it was actually a completely snow-white carrier pigeon, with a piece of paper tied to its foot. He removed the paper, unfolded it, and upon it were only eight characters: 'The envoy's identity, a Chen family old member.' At the signature, unmistakably was the mark of Chen family's direct lineage! Chen Ji's fingers trembled, his eyes flashing with complex brilliance—Chen family old member? Friend or foe? In three days, everything would be revealed..."
